spans.s: --here were sixteen शक्तिस् beginning with दिनमिश्रा; another group of १६ s4aktis commencing with कला is also said to reside here; these were also attached to महाकाल. Br. IV. ३२. ११; १४-16, १९.
--a temple in different shapes; with shining towers. M. २६९. २९, ३४, ३९.
--by giving सर्पि in the श्राद्ध. वा. ७९. ११.
(I)--born from the eastern face of ब्रह्मा. भा. III. १२. ४०.
(II)--the waxing and waning of the moon. वा. ५२. ७०.
--of ललिता; with nine hills and seven seas. Br. IV. ३१. १०-19. [page३-501+ २९]
